recordedAtUtcSource: date -u, read from the shell at write time
recordedBy: claude-code-session, transcribing an exact owner decision
whatThisRecordIs: An IMMUTABLE governance record of the owner's operational INTERPRETATION of a prerequisite the frozen SD9 rule already carries in its own words. It adds no rule, moves no threshold and edits no earlier record. It states which persisted page-evidence rows are eligible to enter the SD7 deduplication pipeline whose output SD9 counts.

boundRelatedDecisions.relationshipBetweenTheTwo: They govern DIFFERENT rows and do not overlap. The short-text rule governs a page that DID extract text but too little to form a token 5-gram. This interpretation governs a page that extracted NO text at all. A page that extracts even one character is never touched by this record and remains subject to the short-text rule exactly as before.

boundFinalOrdinaryWindowAdjudication.correctionMechanism: a NEW record that references it by SHA-256, never a rewrite

theFrozenWordingThisInterprets.verbatim: An organisation is ACQUISITION_SUCCESSFUL iff, after policy-authorised discovery and after SD7 deduplication, it yields at least MIN_PAGES_PER_ORGANISATION = 4 distinct pages with extractable text.
theFrozenWordingThisInterprets.thePhraseIsAPrerequisiteNotADescription: SD9 does not say 'at least 4 distinct pages'. It says 'at least 4 distinct pages WITH EXTRACTABLE TEXT'. A page whose persisted extraction is zero characters long has no extractable text on the only measurement this repository holds, so it was never inside SD9's denominator to begin with.

theImplementationDiscrepancy.whatProductionLegitimatelyPersists: orgunit_page_evidence rows are persisted for a genuine 2xx HTML response with a resolvable charset. persistPageEvidence does NOT reject an empty extraction, so main_text = '' with main_text_chars = 0 is legal, intended production evidence and is NOT a bug.
theImplementationDiscrepancy.whereTheBugWas: DOWNSTREAM, in the SD7 analysis bridge. The bridge passed EVERY persisted page-evidence row into SD7 deduplication. A zero-character main_text produces no token 5-gram shingles at all, so the bridge classified it SD7_SHORT_TEXT_UNRESOLVED and allowed it to contribute 0..1 to the post-SD7 survivor count.
theImplementationDiscrepancy.whyThatIsIncompatibleWithSD9: The upper end of that contribution asserts that a page with zero extracted characters MIGHT be a page with extractable text. It cannot be. SD9's own prerequisite excludes it with certainty, so a range that admits it is not an honest range - it is a range widened by a row SD9 never admitted.
theImplementationDiscrepancy.theConcreteConsequenceObserved: An organisation whose acquisition-of-record run persisted 31 zero-character pages was reported as post-SD7 [0, 31] - a range straddling the threshold of 4 - and therefore held PENDING_CAPABILITY_REVIEW, when the truthful post-SD7 count under SD9's own wording is exactly 0.

ownerDecision.operationalRule: A persisted page-evidence row is eligible for the SD7 to SD9 organisation page-count pipeline iff main_text_chars > 0.
ownerDecision.whyThePredicateIsTheCharacterCountAndNot: main_text_chars is the column the landed schema maintains alongside the text and the one every downstream count already speaks in. The generation-wide audit independently verified that main_text_chars equals the code-point length of main_text on all 2188 persisted rows, so the two predicates are the same predicate on the evidence that exists; the character count is named canonical so a future reader has one answer, not two.

whatIsExplicitlyNOTImposed: no minimum character count above zero

theShortTextBoundaryIsUnmoved.thisRecordDoesNotClassifyShortTextAsEmpt: A page that produces no five-gram shingle is NOT thereby a page with no extractable text. The two conditions were conflated by the defective bridge and are separated by this interpretation.

whyThisIsNotAMethodologyChange.statement: The repair REMOVES rows that fail a prerequisite SD9 already states in its own frozen wording - 'with extractable text' - before SD7 survivor counting. It adds no rule to SD7, no bound to SD9 and no value to any constant.

rawEvidenceIsPreserved.rawPageEvidenceCount: every persisted orgunit_page_evidence row for the run or organisation in question, INCLUDING zero-character rows
onlyTheSecondEntersDeduplication: post-SD7 minimum and maximum survivor counts
rawEvidenceIsPreserved.whatChanged: adjudication ELIGIBILITY, not what was fetched, not what was persisted and not what any prior record says was fetched or persisted.

theExtractorItselfIsUntouched.whyNot: Zero extracted characters is consistent with a client-rendered site, with markup this deliberately narrow extractor cannot read, and with a future extraction-capability opportunity. None of those readings changes the immediate SD9 fact: the persisted extraction yielded zero characters. Whether the extractor should be widened is a separate owner decision with its own measurement, its own ADR and its own rule version.

whatThisRecordDoesNotDo: it does not authorise any acquisition, retry or network request

it does not change production extraction
it does not inspect or disclose any FINAL_HOLDOUT semantic content

immutability.thisRecordIsNeverEdited: A correction is a NEW record that references this one by SHA-256. This file is never rewritten, re-hashed or re-statused.
